summary.result: The permeability of short fiber reinforced soil was increased with fiber mixing ratio.
summary.background: Traditional methods of earth reinforcement consist of introducing strips, fabrics, or grids into an earth mass.
summary.method: In this study, new composite reinforcement structures which consist of geotextile and randomly distributed discrete fibers were examined their engineering properties, such as shear strength of the composite reinforced soil and permeability of short fiber reinforced soil.
